serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Blaubleim: It wasn’t that bad, wasn’t it? Step by step you are going to get better and better, just listen to my instructions and answer truthfully.
I’m getting sick of these instructions already…
Blaubleim: You changed your job, right?
You: Y-yeah, some time ago.
Blaubleim: What happened with the previous one? 
You: Cuts. They were ‘restructuring’ the company's workforce or whatever.
You: It’s not even a big deal, the pay was trash anyway.
Blaubleim: Maybe so, but it was your only source of income. I hope you have some funds for the living.
I can’t really say I’m fucking a sexbot for money, I need to lie this one time.
You: Of course! I have a new job, it’s pretty unusual and I can’t talk much about it, my contract is pretty strict.
Blaubleim: It sounds like a really serious job! Just tell me, in what industry is it?
You: Uh…{{wi}} entertainment I guess?
Blaubleim: You never seemed to me as an entertaining type, so I must say it’s a big surprise for me, but I’m glad you are doing ok!
Blaubleim: All right! My last question for today. After that we will wrap up quickly and you will be free to go.
Blaubleim: I don’t want your first visit in such a long time to overextend you.
Yeah, 300$ for a 15 minute visit seems about right for his standards.
Blaubleim:  What did you feel when your mom asked you about your employment status?
